data.name: Welcome
data.value:
Hi! I'm a bot for saving notes on GitHub. To get started, register your repository with the following command: /register YOUR-GITHUB-TOKEN Owner/Repository
Example: /register githubpat12345 MyUsername/MyObsidianVault
Instructions for obtaining a token: 1) Token generation page: https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new 2) Enter a token name (Token name) 3) Select the token's expiration date (Expiration) 4) Select the repository (Repository access -> Only select repositories) 5) Grant permissions (Permissions -> Add permissions -> Content -> Read and write)
